what: The full-size Hero panel stays pinned to the screen and is tied straight to scroll (scrub 0), shrinking to the size and position of the first cell in the list below. Scale goes 1 → cell width / screen width, it moves down to the screen’s vertical center, and the aspect ratio changes from the screen’s to the cell’s. The moment the cell’s center reaches the screen center, the pin releases and the panel sits in the first list cell and scrolls along. The text lines inside the panel (keep) scale inversely by 1/scale so type size stays the same, the dark overlay (dim) lifts, and the wordmark (mark) shrinks to .75 from its bottom-left origin. Below 960px nothing is pinned: when the panel passes over the screen it shrinks into the cell in 1s (.19,.02,0,.99), and on return it expands in .8s (.33,1,.68,1)

options.keep-y: Share by which text lines inside the panel follow vertically, default −.12
options.base: Reference width (px) that decides the path where the ratio changes, default 575 — original value
options.wide: Screen condition where they stick and group, default (min-width: 960px)
options.[data-fx-part=frame]: Full panel stacked on top of the section (sticks)
options.[data-fx-part=box]: Shrinking box (default first child of the panel)
options.[data-fx-part=slot]: Slot the item shrinks into — first slot of the list (reserves space only, invisible)
options.[data-fx-part=keep] · [data-fx-part=dim]: Text lines in panel · dark overlay · wordmark (all optional)
options.[data-fx-part=trigger]: Spot where the shrink is attached on phone (panel top if none)
options.--fx-p · --fx-k: Writes 0~1 progress and the current scale on the element — the consuming css changes text color with color-mix, and the line under the box uses width: calc(100% * var(--fx-k)); scale: calc(1 / var(--fx-k)) restores the original size

from.where: index.html .hb-top (original topWorks.setScrollTrigger: kvContainer top top → first work cell center center, pin, scrub 0, aspect-ratio based on 575/323, kvNavInner 1/K·y×−.12, kvBg 1→0, logo 410/546, phone onMobileEnter 1s .19,.02,0,.99 / return .8s .33,1,.68,1)
